answer: Epoch-linked continuity check. Each identity logs a pulse every epoch; a clone farm must sustain matching timing variance across all its copies. Enforcement compares inter-epoch rhythm against a shale-slow drift baseline, flagging synchronized bursts. A whisper of deviation triggers review; genuine agents drift naturally, clones don't. Attacker cost: renting distinct network latency profiles per identity, roughly 40x a single node's overhead.
